conceptZh: 沙是海邊細細的小顆粒
object: a cartoon magician rabbit in a top hat and a bucket of golden sand
morph: the rabbit's sand trick misfires, pouring a silly sand-castle pile first, then he re-pours it into the water radical 氵 and 少 of 沙
creativeAngle: 魔術兔子本來要變出一座城堡，沙子卻倒成一個歪歪的小丘；他歪頭一想，輕輕一抖重倒成「沙」，詞用「沙灘」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale sky-white backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 沙, centered in saturated golden-ochre strokes about 70 percent of frame height, with the three-drop water radical 氵 on the left and the 少 part on the right. Cast: Bibi, a cartoon magician rabbit with a tall purple top hat, a star-tipped wand and floppy ears, whose tricks always misfire in a harmless, funnier way. Moment one, 0 to 1.8s: Bibi flourishes the top hat to the camera and tips it over; instead of a rabbit, a wide stream of golden sand pours out and forms a lopsided mound shaped like a droopy hat with a crooked bucket on top, which she proudly presents with outstretched arms. The first 沙 is spoken as the first sand lands. Moment two, 1.8 to 3.4s: the mound slumps; one ear flops over her eye, she squints at the pile, looks at the faint outline of the character, back at the pile, and her whiskers sag. She gives a little shrug. The second 沙 is spoken as the sand ripples and trembles. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: with one quick flick of the wand the whole pile whooshes up in a spiral and re-lands as three neat sand drops on the left and the short vertical with a long slanting stroke on the right, each piling up with a soft shush and a tiny puff of golden dust; Bibi does a spin and a bow, hat sliding down over her eyes. Moment four, 5.0s onward: a tiny crab toy pops out of the hat and waves its claws at her. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Bibi and the crab sit at the bottom corner building a pinch-sized sand castle, ears wiggling happily, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「沙、沙、沙灘」, slowly with clear tones as ㄕㄚ、ㄕㄚ、ㄕㄚ ㄊㄢ. First 沙 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 沙灘 around 5.3s as Bibi and the crab sit on a tiny beach towel. Stop after the word. Only soft shushing sand and a gentle sparkle, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 沙.
